title: DNC normalization of integration on the local diagonal section
statement: Let P be a finite purity setting [def-pur-conventions], Y a Noetherian scheme, aY:Y to Spec k a locally finite-type quasi-compact structure morphism, and d a natural number. Let p:A^d_Y to Y be the ordered affine projection [def-amb-affine-trace-tower], assumed smooth of relative dimension d. Let V be an affine open of Y and E a normalized DNC Chart for p,aY,d,V [lem-pur-diagonal-orientation-refinement]. Put B=p inverse V, h=p restricted to V, and s=diagonal h. For any normalized finite twist transport t and P1 family D [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows, def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-data], let S be the actual affine section trace over B [def-pur-restricted-affine-diagonal-section-trace]. Let delta be the chosen normalized DNC isomorphism C(pr1,s) to C(normal projection,zero), and beta the normal-section comparison of E. Then S followed by delta followed by beta is the identity of A_B(d)[2d]. The equation involves neither alpha nor rho nor the affine counit over Y.

proof.text: Obtain a common vector presentation of source and normal from restrictedAffineDiagonalDncVectorCoordinates and its geometric DNC equation.

Apply restrictedAffineDiagonalVectorIntegration to the source presentation. Apply E.normalized to the normal presentation: betaEtale.inv followed by cN.hom is vectorBetaInverse. Map this equation through nu-star.

Precompose the DNC equation by the local section trace and substitute the integration and beta-normalization equations. Cancel nu-star(cN.hom). This gives S followed by delta and normalComparison equal to nu-star(betaEtale.inv). Unfold beta and cancel betaEtale.inv followed by betaEtale.hom. Associativity and functoriality finish.

theorem restrictedAffineDiagonalDncTrace (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] (d : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (affineTraceProjection Y d)]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (E : OrientationRefinement.Chart P (affineTraceProjection Y d) aY d V)
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
      (hT : IsUnit (P.diagonalExponent : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      Etale.OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t T hT) :
    OrientationCounit.restrictedAffineDiagonalSectionTrace P Y d aY V E.geometry t D ≫
        (OrientationRefinement.delta P (affineTraceProjection Y d) aY d V E.geometry).hom ≫
        (OrientationRefinement.beta P (affineTraceProjection Y d) aY d V
          E.geometry E.betaEtale).hom =
      𝟙 (P.diagonalTwist (affineTraceProjection Y d ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme d)
